title.narrative: The Schuman Security and Defence Forum is intended to provide a venue for an international encounter among politicians, policy and opinion makers, public diplomatic exchanges, and an opportunity for informal gatherings. It is intended to complement existing highlevel venues for strategic exchange in international security and to serve as a platform for the EU to elevate its profile in the security and defence agenda and to showcase its contribution to international peace and security. It also aims to establish a stronger sense of community with those countries with which the EU has a security and defence cooperation.
